props.name: stats
props.description: Stat tiles (four in the demo, which share the first row).

props.name: values
props.description: Chart bars in their own unit, scaled to the largest; zero, negative and non-finite values draw no bar.

props.name: percent
props.description: Ring fill, 0–100 (default 61); a non-finite value draws no arc and reads "—".

props.name: labels
props.description: UI text; every key is optional and falls back to the English default.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the ring percentage (default `"en-US"`).

props.name: animated
props.description: Play the entrance animation (default false). When false, render the final state.

props.name: fill
props.description:
Make the visual fill the box it is given instead of sitting in the gallery preview frame: drops the frame's side padding, stretches on the cross axis and removes the module's `max-w-*` cap. Off by default, so the preview rendering — and every golden — is unchanged.

Turn it on to use a visual as a panel in an app layout, where a centred, capped card gives mismatched widths and edges from one cell to the next.

props.name: chartTitle
props.description: Title and period of the bar chart.

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown in the chart when `values` is empty.

props.name: icon
props.description: A lucide icon component (default: the demo icon of that position).
